autoCutoff.title: Automatic power cutoff
autoCutoff.intro: When this is on, a 1Meter-primary account loses power at zero credit. A payment that restores credit turns power back on. SparkMeter accounts are unchanged.
autoCutoff.who: Superadmin can save any country. O&M and finance can save only their own country. The change is recorded in the mutation log, with who changed it and when.
autoCutoff.firmware: Gateways below firmware 1.1.74 are skipped. Older builds freeze or reverse open and close.
autoCutoff.pickCountry: Pick Lesotho, Benin, or Zambia in the sidebar. All countries does not change this switch.
autoCutoff.readOnly: Read-only for your role or country.
autoCutoff.locked: An operations lock is on. This switch cannot turn cutoff on.
autoCutoff.confirmOn: Turn on automatic power cutoff for this country? 1Meter accounts at zero credit will lose power. This is recorded in the mutation log.
autoCutoff.confirmOff: Turn off automatic power cutoff for this country? 1Meter accounts will no longer lose power at zero credit. This is recorded in the mutation log.
autoCutoff.saved: Saved. The mutation log has the previous value, the new value, and your name.
autoCutoff.noop: Already set that way. Nothing was recorded.

siteHold.title: Electricity billing hold
siteHold.intro: Hold a site until the regulator allows electricity sales. Meters stay on and keep reporting. That use is free. Connection and readyboard fees still collect. Money sent for electricity is saved and becomes units when you clear the site, at the tariff from the day it was paid. To test billing on one meter while the site is still held, set that meter to Bill.
siteHold.held: {{code}} is on free supply. The relay is held closed unless a safety override is on.
siteHold.billed: {{code}} is billing. {{count}} saved payments became {{kwh}} kWh.
siteHold.meterIntro: One meter can bill while its site is still held. Hours before this switch stay free. Type BILL and the meter id, or FOLLOW and the meter id to use the site rule again.
siteHold.meterBilled: {{meter}} bills even while its site is held.
siteHold.readOnly: You can see this. Only a superadmin, or O&M for this country, can change it.
